why: This single 1337-line file re-tests the same methods twice under near-identical group names, added across separate fix waves that evidently never checked for existing coverage: removeMilestone (line 469 AND 496), stripStockTemplateMilestones (line 920 AND 978, with two more '(F2 variant)' echoes at 1024/1041 of the exact same 50/150/300-legacy-tier scenario), and mergeCloudPayload's null/empty no-op cases (1078/1083 duplicated at 1160/1165). Separately, lines 96-207 re-test RewardMilestone/RewardUnlockRecord fromJson/toJson/copyWith — coverage that already exists, more thoroughly, in the dedicated test/features/gamification/domain/models/reward_milestone_test.dart. This is the exact 'dumping ground... drives re-implementation elsewhere' failure the AG-3 rule rationale predicts, and it is not hypothetical here — it already happened four times over in this file.
recommendation: Merge each duplicate group pair into one, keep the strongest assertions, delete the redundant ones; move the model round-trip tests out in favor of the dedicated reward_milestone_test.dart.
acceptance_criteria: grep -c "group('.*removeMilestone" / stripStockTemplateMilestones / mergeCloudPayload in the file each return 1, not 2.
dart test test/features/gamification/domain/services/reward_milestone_service_test.dart stays green with an equal-or-lower total test count covering the same unique scenarios.
